name: custom-generators
description: Custom Generators — a Civitai App Block (full-page) authoring app. Users BUILD named 'generators' (a set of buttons, each carrying an image-generation payload: pinned checkpoint + weighted LoRA stack + prompt template + params), with a live preview and inferred runtime inputs (prompt box from a {prompt} token, image box from img2img); publish them app-scoped, and RUN them (buttons + prompt input + img2img source + advanced params + an output queue). Mobile-first + desktop-responsive. Phase 2a = image generation (txt2img + img2img).
